definitions.explanation: The capital city of Japan, located in the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}に{住|す}んでいます。
{東京|とうきょう}は{日本|にほん}の{首都|しゅと}です。
examples.english: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}、{東京|とうきょう}に{行|い}く{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I plan to go to Tokyo next week.

notes:
{東京|とうきょう} literally means "eastern capital" ({東|ひがし} east + {京|きょう} capital). It became the capital when the emperor moved from {京都|きょうと} (Kyoto, "capital city") in 1868.

ADMINISTRATIVE TERMS:
- {東京都|とうきょうと}: Tokyo Metropolis (official name; unique administrative status, not a {県|けん})
- {都内|とない}: within Tokyo (used like "in Tokyo" for urban areas)
- {都心|としん}: central Tokyo (the core business/government area)
- {首都圏|しゅとけん}: Greater Tokyo Area (includes surrounding prefectures)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {東京|とうきょう}に{住|す}む: to live in Tokyo
- {東京|とうきょう}に{行|い}く: to go to Tokyo
- {東京|とうきょう}{出身|しゅっしん}: from Tokyo

USAGE:
Informally, {東京|とうきょう} often refers specifically to the 23 special wards ({特別区|とくべつく}), while {東京都|とうきょうと} includes western suburban areas as well.
